name: Create a personal hero and retain the look
description: Verifies a player can preview class silhouettes, save a personal appearance, and continue freely with the saved hero.
steps: Open Customize character; choose Knight in Class to try.
Set Skin tone to Deep, Hair style to Braided, Hair color to Silver, Clothing palette to Ocean, Metal trim to Copper and Build to Broad.
Try Walk and Attack previews and turn the character left and right.
Choose Save look, walk a short distance, and reload.
Reopen Customize character.
expected: The Knight and all chosen appearance fields remain selected after reload; the hero uses the saved look in the world, previews animate, and no quest is required before moving.

name: Discover the western passage through the world
description: Verifies a player can follow the western road into the short cave scene and return.
steps: Approach the weathered signpost north of the starting hearth using movement or ground clicks.
Interact with the signpost and choose Follow the western road.
Wait for the hero to arrive on foot, then choose Step through.
Explore the cave entrance and open Journal.
Close Journal, open Pause and settings, and choose Return to Mossvale.
expected: The cave scene shows The Amber Hollows with its own stone environment and local discovery entry, and returning restores Ruined Mossvale without erasing the journal.

name: Choose the high road independently
description: Verifies the high road can be chosen without first completing the cave and that an entrance can be declined.
steps: Approach and interact with the weathered signpost north of the hearth.
Choose Follow the high steps and let the hero walk to the entrance.
Choose Keep exploring here to decline entry.
Interact with the nearby entrance again and choose Step through.
Explore the terrace briefly, then use Pause and settings to Return to Mossvale.
expected: Declining keeps the hero in Mossvale; entering later shows The Windward Terrace without requiring cave completion, and returning preserves the discovered places.

name: Move and fight with touch controls
description: Verifies mobile directional/action controls support movement and a readable encounter.
steps: Hold a direction-pad button and verify the hero moves; release it and verify movement stops.
Choose Ranger if available, approach the signpost, and follow either road into a short encounter.
Move toward a visible enemy; use Attack and Piercing shot while staying clear of red warning circles.
If the hero falls, choose Wake in Mossvale; otherwise retreat using Pause and settings, Return to Mossvale.
Open Journal.
expected: Touch controls work without horizontal scrolling, attacks produce visible damage and vitality feedback, returning or waking remains playable, and discoveries survive.

name: Pause safely and protect the local save from accidental reset
description: Verifies mobile customization can be canceled and menus safely isolate controls while protecting the local save.
steps: Hold a direction button briefly, release it, and open Customize character.
Change the Clothing palette and Class to try, then choose Cancel.
Reopen Customize character and verify the saved values remain; close it.
Open Pause and settings and enable Reduce ambient motion and effects.
Choose Start a fresh demo, then Keep exploring.
Open Pause and settings again, choose Start a fresh demo, and confirm Start again.
expected: The editor works without horizontal scrolling and the hero remains still while it is open; Cancel keeps the previous look and class. Canceling reset retains the journey; confirming starts fresh at the hearth and affects no live account.
